metadata.notes: DeepSeek Harness starts a durable continuable background child, but the DSH adapter rejects its bare UUID directory and does not read the durable parentSession header.

assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: yes
daemon_capability: bug
driver_capability: ready

## Agent capability

DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.2 ships a first-class `subagent` tool. The installed official package reference states that continuable mode starts a durable child in the background and returns its id without waiting. The shipped standard preset configures `subagent` with the in-process spawn provider and `backgroundMode: continuable`. The tool schema exposes `run_in_background`, defaults it to true in this mode, and the runtime calls `startContinuable` when the value is true. The recipe sets the value explicitly.

The in-process driver creates a separate child Agent and Session. It assigns a bare `randomUUID()` child id. `childSessionMeta` writes the parent's durable session id to `parentSession` and writes `origin: subagent` in the child session header. The persistence backend writes each session to its own directory under the same sessions root. The TUI source confirms that a child id and its persisted directory use the same bare UUID. Thus the agent emits a durable child transcript and an exact child-to-parent link while the parent can end its own turn without waiting.

## Daemon capability

The current DSH adapter mishandles those traces in two concrete ways. First, `sessionIDFromPath` accepts only directory names matching `^session-<uuid>$`. It returns an empty id for the bare UUID directory created by the official child driver. `FilesUnderRoot` therefore skips the child transcript, so no child `SessionState` or `transcript_new` event appears. Second, `Source()` does not set `ParentSessionIDFromPath`, although the first physical child header contains `parentSession`. The parser handles the session header only for version and cwd and discards the parent field. Even after the id filter is widened, the child remains top-level, `parent_linked` does not fire, `SubagentCount(parent)` stays zero, and `hasActiveChildren` cannot hold the parent in working after its own completed boundary.

This verdict is `daemon=bug`, not `incapable`. The required child transcript and parent id exist under the root that the adapter already tails. Irrlicht already has the `ParentSessionIDFromPath` seam for a metadata-header relationship. The expected spec therefore asserts the correct held-working behavior and marks it known-failing.

## Driver capability and recipe

The interactive driver implements `send`, `wait_turn`, and `sleep`, which are the only required steps. The prompt requires exactly one `subagent` call with `run_in_background:true`, gives the child a deterministic 50-second shell delay, forbids parent polling, and pins the parent's final reply. The 600-second budget covers the parent decision, the local child model's two decisions, the deliberate delay, and the trailing observation window. The 120-second sleep exceeds the longest committed sibling delay of 95 seconds because the local LM Studio child must make a tool-selection request and a final response around the deliberate 50-second command.

The raw parent-transcript assertion requires the explicit background argument and the immediate durable child-id result. The lifecycle phases require a distinct child session, its parent link, a parent held in working for at least 30 seconds, and the parent's final ready transition only after the child drains. An ordinary turn or a foreground child cannot satisfy both parts. The model and token observations use the exact route installed by the driver. Cost can remain zero because the route is local LM Studio.
caveats: Known daemon bug: core/adapters/inbound/agents/dsh/adapter.go accepts only session-<uuid> directory names, but @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-in-process-driver creates a bare UUID child id. The fswatcher therefore skips the durable child transcript.

Known daemon bug: the DSH child session header carries parentSession, but core/adapters/inbound/agents/dsh/agent.go declares no ParentSessionIDFromPath extractor and parser.go discards that header field. No parent_linked event or SubagentCount can be produced until the adapter reads it.

Emission is source-confirmed but not live-recorded in this cell. A recording must confirm that the installed TUI profile persists the continuable child and that the parent turn/end precedes the child's turn/end.

Vacuous-pass condition: the parent lifecycle alone could pass after an ordinary turn or a foreground child. The transcript assertion therefore requires exactly one subagent call with run_in_background:true and its immediate started-subagent result, while the phases require a distinct linked child and a held-working span of at least 30 seconds.

Load-bearing environment precondition: the active standard preset must expose the in-process continuable subagent tool, and LM Studio must expose qwen/qwen3.5-9b. Record must re-probe both instead of trusting this assessment.

The canonical scenario row is internally inconsistent. Its description and daemon code require the parent to stay working and include the live child, while process and acceptance_criteria retain the superseded ready-at-parent-end and exclude-child rule. This cell follows the description, detector code, and recorded claudecode sibling.
The child runs in the same dsh process and uses a bare UUID. Do not require a distinct child PID. Require a distinct child SessionState and ParentSessionID link.

sources.note: Official installed package reference: continuable background calls return a durable child id immediately and do not wait for a result.
The shipped standard preset mounts the spawn-backed subagent tool with backgroundMode continuable.
The tool schema exposes run_in_background, defaults it to true for continuable mode, and routes true to startContinuable.
The official installed implementation creates a separate child with a bare randomUUID and passes childSessionMeta into Agent creation.
childSessionMeta writes parentSession and origin subagent into the durable child header.
Official persistence contract: each session gets its own directory and physical header under the configured sessions root.
Installed TUI source states that a child id is bare and its persisted directory uses the same bare id.
sessionIDPattern requires session-<uuid>; sessionIDFromPath rejects the official bare UUID child directory.
FilesUnderRoot declares SessionIDFromPath but no ParentSessionIDFromPath extractor.
parseSession validates the version and reads cwd, then skips the header without reading parentSession.
ParentSessionIDFromPath is the existing daemon seam for transcript stores whose parent relationship lives in a metadata header.
hasActiveChildren and parent reevaluation hold a linked parent in working until the active child drains.
ComputeSubagentSummary includes file-backed children whose ParentSessionID matches the parent.
The driver implements send, wait_turn, and sleep and pins the local LM Studio model through per-run settings.

preconditions: dsh 0.1.5-rc.2 or newer is on PATH and the active TUI profile uses the standard preset
the active preset exposes the in-process continuable subagent tool and accepts run_in_background:true; re-probe the live tool surface at record time
LM Studio is serving qwen/qwen3.5-9b through http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1; re-probe the live model roster at record time
irrlichd is recording with DeepSeek Harness transcript permission granted
setup: Create a fresh per-run cwd and launch the DSH TUI through the interactive driver
Apply the temporary LM Studio and qwen model patch without modifying the installed TUI profile
Resolve the post-marker parent session.v3.jsonl.zstd before sending input

script.text: Use the subagent tool exactly once. Set description to delayed marker. Set prompt to: Use the bash tool to run exactly `sleep 50 && printf CHILD_DONE`. After it succeeds, reply with exactly CHILD_DONE and no other text. Set run_in_background to true. Do not call send_message, list_agents, or any result-reading tool. Do not wait for the child. As soon as the subagent tool returns its durable child id, reply with exactly LAUNCHED and no other text.

verify: the raw parent transcript contains exactly one subagent tool call whose arguments explicitly set run_in_background to true
the subagent call has a matching successful result containing started subagent and a durable child id
the parent's completed turn/end follows the start result and precedes the child's completed turn/end, which distinguishes this background run from a foreground clone
the raw child transcript header carries origin subagent and parentSession equal to the parent session id
events.jsonl shows a distinct child transcript_new event and parent_linked for that child
the parent stays working for at least 30 seconds after the child link, with no ready or waiting transition while the child is active
the child reaches ready and only then the parent reaches ready
the recording reports model qwen/qwen3.5-9b and non-zero tokens
recipe.scope_note: await_child_turn_end scans only transcript files newer than this run's marker. It discovers a bare-UUID child only when its durable header has origin subagent and parentSession equal to the active parent. It polls that child transcript until a completed turn/end or the scenario deadline. It fails loudly for an absent child, unreadable child transcript, wrong current-run parent, or missing completed turn/end.
